value.title: Fleet rested 2026-11-10 19:26; pa state and round procedure

sections.name: body
sections.value:
The prime (pij-outstanding-silkworm since 10 Nov 16:15) rested the fleet at 19:26: no new work until Jordan names it. pm-001 asked every seat to bring its memory note up to date.

pa state at rest: nothing in flight. No handshake pending, no compact held. Lemur, salmon and starfish hold no roles; guan holds docs-system and waits for pm-001's ping; kestrel, squirrel, ocelot and pm-001 are idle. Spoonbill is gone (process exited; memory note 9c30f54). Closed this wind-down, each after its memory note: herring, bobcat, tapir, wildcat, spoonbill.

How a round runs now, from the 08-10 Nov notes:
- Sizes: read the pane footer (NNNk/1.0M or NNNk/922k) and the last session.compaction_complete in the seat's events.jsonl. The digest and pm-001's figures go stale after a compaction (F170).
- Handshake: handover first (a file, or pij output and its commit), "handover ready" once, then pij send <seat> --command compact. Verify in events.jsonl. A held compact can be dropped (F180); escalate after one drop.
- The daemon's post-compaction wake is automatic (plan 222). Still flag seats with live holdings idle over an hour, and reviewers who queue work for a "next turn".
- Reply to requests with pij_send in_reply_to. Escalations go to the prime silkworm.
- My seat: 559k at rest; compact-self past 600k.
